name: Kalaignar Magalir Urimai Thogai Scheme
shortDescription: Monthly financial assistance of ₹1,000 to women aged 45-60 in Tamil Nadu.
description: A Tamil Nadu government scheme providing monthly financial assistance of ₹1,000 to women between 45-60 years of age. The scheme aims to provide financial support to women during their golden years. The amount is transferred directly to the beneficiary's bank account.
sourceOrganization: Tamil Nadu Social Welfare and Nutritious Meal Program Department

benefits.text: Monthly financial assistance of ₹1,000 (₹12,000 per year)

rules.description: All of the following must be true.
Applicant must be a resident of Tamil Nadu.
Applicant must be at least 45 years old.
Applicant must be 60 years or younger.
Annual family income must be at most ₹2,00,000.

requiredDocuments.name: Aadhaar card
requiredDocuments.description: Proof of identity, address and bank linkage. Keep the original with you.

requiredDocuments.name: Proof of age
requiredDocuments.description: Birth certificate, SSLC mark sheet, or any other age proof document.

requiredDocuments.name: Tamil Nadu residence proof
requiredDocuments.description: Ration card, voter ID, or any document showing your address in Tamil Nadu.

requiredDocuments.name: Bank passbook with Aadhaar linkage
requiredDocuments.description: First page of bank passbook showing Aadhaar number is linked for DBT.

requiredDocuments.name: Income certificate
requiredDocuments.description: Income certificate issued by the concerned Tahsildar or competent authority.

requiredDocuments.name: Passport-size photograph
requiredDocuments.description: Recent passport-size photograph of the applicant.

applicationSteps.text: Collect all required documents (Aadhaar, age proof, residence proof, bank passbook, income certificate, photograph).
Visit the nearest Social Welfare Office, Women and Child Development Office, or Taluk Service Centre in your area.
Obtain the application form from the office counter. Some offices may provide online forms on the official website.
Fill in the application form with correct personal and family details.
Attach photocopies of all required documents (attested by a gazetted officer if required).
Submit the completed application to the concerned office. Ask for an acknowledgment receipt.
Your application will be verified by the gram panchayat/ward level committee and then by the block level committee.
If approved, the benefit amount will be transferred directly to your bank account via DBT (Direct Benefit Transfer).
